buildImplementsAutoFix: - Requires exactly one distinct story path (storyPaths.size === 1). - Requires exactly one @story line, at least one @req line, and non-null storyPath. - Builds a new annotation: "@supports ${storyPath} ${reqIds.join(" ")}". - traceability.notes: Story 010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-SUPPORTS is fully implemented. The prefer-implements-annotation ESLint rule detects legacy @story + @req usage, emits optional recommendations, and provides a conservative auto-fix that converts single-story comments with one or multiple @reqs into a single @supports line while preserving comment structure. Multi-story and mixed @supports/@story/@req patterns are detected and reported without auto-fix. The rule is disabled by default and controlled entirely via ESLint severity (off/warn/error), maintaining backward compatibility and ensuring both legacy and new formats remain valid when the rule is off. Comprehensive unit tests directly tied to this story verify all key behaviors and configuration aspects, and a dedicated documentation page serves as the migration guide with examples and configuration instructions. All tests pass, so every acceptance criterion in the story is satisfied.
